summary: REQ-10 and REQ-11 appear implemented in the frontend (Discord community info in Footer; explicit guest messaging in NavBar and UploadPage). The Live MVP UI/routes and React Query hooks are added (Live list page + details page + nav entry). However, the diff summary does not include concrete evidence that the backend exposes the required live-session canister methods (create/end/list/fetch) with the specified access control; the backend file is truncated before those methods would be visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes canister methods to create, end, list, and fetch live session metadata, with access control that prevents guests from creating/ending sessions and prevents users from ending sessions they did not start.
missing_requirements.reason: Although live session types and a liveSessions map are shown, the diff summary is truncated and does not show the actual public/shared canister methods (e.g., start/create, end, list, get) or their authorization checks. Frontend hooks call actor.getAllActiveLiveSessions(), actor.getLiveSession(...), and mutations for start/end, but the corresponding backend implementations are not visible in the provided diff excerpt.
